modern.label: Modern 2025/2026 Optimized
modern.description: Reflects hardware/software inference optimizations, quantization, and closed-loop or low-WUE hyperscale cooling.
modern.source: Google Environmental Report (2025) & epoch.ai inference efficiency benchmarks

conservative.label: Conservative / Older IEA Baseline
conservative.description: Reflects unoptimized 2022-2023 dense LLM estimates and evaporative cooling in moderately water-stressed grids.
conservative.source: IEA Electricity 2024 / de Vries (2023) & Li et al. (2023) 'Making AI Less Thirsty'

burger_water_l.label: 1 Beef Burger (150g patty)
burger_water_l.scope: Blue + green + grey water footprint (feed irrigation, drinking, processing)

streaming_hd_wh_per_hr.label: 1 Hour of HD Video Streaming
streaming_hd_wh_per_hr.scope: Data center + CDN transmission + home router + TV/laptop display
streaming_hd_wh_per_hr.source: IEA (2023) / Carbon Trust Video Streaming Impact Report

grid_carbon_intensity_g_per_kwh.label: Global Average Grid Carbon Intensity
grid_carbon_intensity_g_per_kwh.scope: Location-based average (varies from ~30g in hydro/nuclear grids to >600g in coal-heavy grids)
grid_carbon_intensity_g_per_kwh.source: IEA World Energy Outlook / Ember Global Electricity Review

global_agriculture_blue_water_km3.label: Animal Agriculture (Blue Water Only)
global_agriculture_blue_water_km3.scope: Surface and groundwater withdrawals for livestock feed & drinking (excludes rainwater)

global_ai_datacenter_water_2028_km3.label: AI Data Centers (2028 Projection)
global_ai_datacenter_water_2028_km3.scope: Direct on-site cooling + indirect thermoelectric power plant cooling + semiconductor fab water
global_ai_datacenter_water_2028_km3.source: Li et al. (2023) / Ren et al. (UC Riverside)

global_dc_twh.note: AI-optimized servers drive ~75% of incremental growth
